points.description: States that the statement is TRUE. This mark is only awarded if the student also gives a correct justification (P2), since the question gives no marks for a verdict without justification.

Justifies that the user process has no control over which process is scheduled next, because the scheduler (the OS) decides which READY process runs next. Equivalent wording is accepted, for example that a user process cannot force a context switch to the process whose PID it knows, or that the choice of next process belongs to the scheduler.
